name: After Work
detailed_description:
You have just been hired as a marketing photographer for SPARK: the leading force in designing and manufacturing professional-quality cameras. Your team is full of young, attractive professionals all working towards one goal: to create a campaign that highlights the faces behind the company. Though your contract only lasts 6 months, you plan to make the most of it: both in and out of the office! While on the clock, collaborate with your team on the campaign and get to know them in a casual workplace setting. After work, form deep, meaningful connections with the coworker of your choosing and watch a romance bloom.

Features:

-Power of observation: Analyze a character and determine their emotional state through body language, facial expressions, and other subtle details. Does their hand shiver when you try to hold it? Are their arms wrapped around their torso when you’re going in for a hug? Do they take a small step back when you attempt to kiss them? Look carefully, as someone might not consent to your actions, even if they don’t voice it.

-A diverse cast of LGBTQA+ characters: Get to know your coworkers at SPARK, the leading force in everything professional photography! Romance five different characters, each with their own unique backstory and personality. Grab a bite to eat during your lunch breaks, explore Lucante City on a date, or make yourself comfortable in each others’ apartments.

-Realistic relationship progression: Take your time to really get to know your love interest. Chat with them in the office about their interests. Go on multiple dates, revealing more of their story and deep secrets. Good things take time, and a romantic relationship is no different!

-Unlockable erotic scenes: Successful dates and blossoming relationships will lead to some steamy scenes where your choices determine how they play out! Each character will have fully rendered explicit images to amp up the spice. But, don’t forget to ensure that your partner consents before you get down and dirty!

-Choice matters: Choose your dialogue options wisely! With differing personalities comes different sensitivities, tolerances, and boundaries. No two characters respond identically to the same question. Will you answer with humor or with empathy? What questions should be asked to impress your love interest? One wrong move, and a burgeoning relationship could be sabotaged.
